verdict.rationale: Poly is a cloud file-storage SaaS with an official MCP server and CLI, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The pack has no evidence of API versioning, version identifiers on the MCP endpoint, or any documented deprecation or sunset policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Its file-level versioning (Flashback, revision history) is an adjacent feature about file contents, not API versions, so it earns no credit.
